# OpenTelemetry GPU Collector 1.0.0

## Features

- Skips write disk metrics for read-only Linux block devices; reporting resumes when devices become writable. Missing or invalid read-only indicators are treated as writable. ([#1397](https://github.com/openlit/openlit/pull/1397))

## Fixes

- Adds hw.id device attribution to CUDA events on multi-GPU hosts, using per-thread current device with CUDA 0 fallback and stale PID cleanup. ([#1541](https://github.com/openlit/openlit/pull/1541))
- GPU processes are n

- Adds Mem0, Claude, and Zep memory connectors with list/search/detail, writes, copy, feedback, Ask Otter integration, and project-environment scoping. ([#1490](https://github.com/openlit/openlit/pull/1490))
- Adds stuck-agent loop detection on traces: a Loop filter chip flags repeated tool calls, with counts and wasted token/cost details across ClickHouse, Tempo, and Jaeger. ([#1494](https://github.com/openlit/openlit/pull/1494))
- Fixes onboarding step 3 by embedding database configuration inline and allo

## 0.15.8 - 2026-10-16

**Highlights:** Recover cloud logins automatically after confirmed GitHub rate limits.

- Retry confirmed GitHub cloud-login rate limits after their cooldown, with bounded waits and distinct credential diagnostics.
- Update Crawlkit to v0.17.0 and refresh provider, network, telemetry, and Go analysis dependencies while retaining Go 1.27.0 and the matching SQLite/libc runtime; expose an explicit release-pipeline dry run for build verification without publishing.

## 0.15.7 - 2026-10-11

**Highlights:** Fix nine reachable Go standard-library vulnerabilities and the gRPC xDS denial-of-service advisory.

- Build with Go 1.27.2 to fix nine reachable standard-library vulnerabilities, including in Docker and optional language helpers, while retaining the existing minimum Go versions; refresh Go system, text, cryptography, terminal ANSI, and character-width dependencies, and run analyzers with the compatible module-pinned export reader.
- Update transitive gRPC to v1.83.2
- Refresh SQLite to v1.60.1 with its required libc v1.77.1, go-strftime to v1.1.0, and golangci-lint to v2.14.0, retaining the Go 1.27.0 minimum.

- Add explicit public Discord invite-count collection, scoped history import, and read-only status in a separate metrics database, preserving partial observations and existing archives. Thanks @hannesrudolph.
- Refresh SQLite to v1.59.0 with its matching libc v1.75.7, go-humanize to v1.1.0, and terminfo to v1.2.0; retain the Go 1.27.0 minimum and current published Crawlkit v0.16.4.

## 0.15.4 - 2026-09-20

- Update Crawlkit to v0.16.4 so normal snapshot updates accept equivalent attachment schemas with reordered columns, preserving locally retained history without requiring forced replacement.

Security patch release. No feature changes.

### Security Fixes

- **GHSA-6pch-62r9-hqf2** - High severity unauthenticated bid placement (CWE-306)
  - The bid endpoint accepted a client-supplied `farmerId` without authentication, allowing anyone to place binding bids in another farmer's name.
  - Fixed by requiring authentication, enforcing the `FARMER` role, and deriving the `farmerId` strictly from the server session.

Security patch release. No feature changes.

### Security Fixes

- **GHSA-369m-w6hw-7r89** - Critical privilege escalation (CWE-269)
  - `setUserRole` accepted a client-controlled role with no runtime validation, allowing any signed-in user to self-assign `SUPER_ADMIN`
  - Fixed with a runtime allow-list and an atomic conditional update
  - Reported by [@orshih6](https://github.com/orshih6)
